title: Alpine+Nix Needle scenarios
description: Illustrative natural-language requests for the named tool catalog. Needle predictions are probabilistic: expectedTool is an example, never a guaranteed outcome or test oracle. All operations are independently tested via explicit JSON call dispatch.
